functional.statement: Minigene splicing assay (construct, not patient RNA): a WT TNFAIP3 exon 7-9 minigene and the c.2088+1G>A minigene were transfected into HEK293T cells; RT-PCR and sequencing of the variant minigene showed skipping of exon 8, written as c.1906_2097del; p.His636GlufsX. WT minigene was the control.

quotes.quote: The *TNFIAP3* splice-site variants c.487-1G\>A, c.805+1G\>A, c.986+1G\>T, and c.2088+1G\>A were generated using KOD FX Neo and the KOD Plus Mutagenesis Kit (Toyobo Co., Ltd., Japan).
Direct sequencing of the PCR product from the c.2088+1G\>A minigene showed a skipping of exon 8 (c.1906_2097del; p.His636GlufsX) (**Supplementary Figure 4E**).

Wild-type (WT) DNA segments of *TNFAIP3* extending from exons 3 to 8 (~ 5.4 kb) and from exons 7 to 9 (~ 4.9 kb) were cloned into plasmid pCAGGS (3) for use as the minigene splicing constructs WTex3-8 and WTex7-9.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Canonical splice-donor change (+1), protein not predictable from the cDNA alone (batch: p.?). The paper reports exon 8 skipping in a minigene and writes the protein as p.His636GlufsX55. The paper attributes the disease to heterozygous loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).
All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

concerns: The paper contradicts itself on the variant name: the tables and pedigree give c.2088+1G>A for patient 49, but the Results text says 'patient 49 (c.2099 + 1G>A)'.
Protein differs from the batch prediction: the paper states p.His636GlufsX55 (from the minigene result); the batch gives p.? for a splice variant (protein_check: differs).

The minigene result is written as c.1906_2097del, while the paper's own splice-site names (c.1906+1G>A in family 4, c.2088+1G>A here) imply exon 8 spans c.1907 to c.2088; the stated deleted interval does not match those boundaries. The panel should check Supplementary Figure 4E.
The splice-site list in the methods has c.986+1G>T while the results and gel use c.986+1G>C; not this variant, but it shows notation slips in the same paragraph.
notes_for_panel: Single proband. The functional evidence is a minigene assay showing exon 8 skipping; no patient RNA study is reported.
